items.content_html:
I think this does what I want, but I'd appreciate someone more knowledgeable chiming in!
@lovesegfault and @sternenseemann made and reviewed the last related change here.

When we must build, prefer building locally since we probably already have the manpages here. Otherwise, Nix would send all the manpages to a remote builder which isn't likely to be much faster since building the DB is single-threaded. Hopefully a best-of-both worlds between keeping or removing 39e63f1.
